scripts.electron:start: npm run build && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron .
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleStandardDebug
scripts.android:build:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleStandardRelease
scripts.android:build:local-release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleStandardLocalRelease
scripts.android:build:unsigned-release: npm run android:sync && cd android && WEB_TERMINAL_ANDROID_ALLOW_UNSIGNED_RELEASE=true ./gradlew assembleStandardRelease
scripts.android:build:pad:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assemblePadDebug
scripts.android:build:pad:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assemblePadRelease
scripts.android:build:pad:local-release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assemblePadLocalRelease
scripts.android:build:pad:unsigned-release: npm run android:sync && cd android && WEB_TERMINAL_ANDROID_ALLOW_UNSIGNED_RELEASE=true ./gradlew assemblePadRelease
